Mini-funk test API with txn, rec, and funk structs plus helper functions.

# Purpose
This header defines the shared data structures and helper functions for a small `mini-funk` implementation used for reference and testing. It declares the `rec`, `txn`, and `funk` types, which store transaction links, record links, key and value data, and list and map heads and tails. It also declares the main transaction, record, and container APIs, such as [`txn_prepare`](<#txn_prepare>), [`txn_cancel`](<#txn_cancel>), [`txn_publish`](<#txn_publish>), [`rec_query`](<#rec_query>), [`rec_insert`](<#rec_insert>), [`funk_new`](<#funk_new>), and [`funk_delete`](<#funk_delete>), plus inline helpers for checking transaction state and walking parent, child, and sibling links. The file also includes test utilities for creating and comparing transaction IDs and record keys with [`xid_set`](<#xid_set>), [`xid_eq`](<#xid_eq>), `key_set`, and [`key_eq`](<#key_eq>).
